description: Voltage-controlled lag processor with a slope detector, limiting how fast its output can follow its input

params.text: Bends the slope, straight counter-clockwise and increasingly curved clockwise as the gap to the input shrinks
Picks the span of the slew times: Fast is 4ms to 4 seconds, Medium 40ms to 40 seconds, Slow 400ms to 400 seconds, despite the source comment naming them the other way round
Sets how long the output takes to climb, longer the higher it goes; when the CV MODE switch routes the CV input to the rise, this slider attenuates that CV instead
Sets how long the output takes to drop, longer the higher it goes; when the CV MODE switch routes the CV input to the fall, this slider attenuates that CV instead
Chooses what the CV input controls: the fall time, both times, or the rise time

inputs.text: Sets the slew time over 0-10V, attenuated by the slider for whichever stage the CV MODE switch has picked

outputs.text: The input signal with its rate of change limited by the rise and fall times
10V for as long as the output is climbing towards the input, and 0V otherwise
10V for as long as the output is dropping towards the input, and 0V otherwise
